reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface theme that applies Cyberpunk 2077-inspired colors, typography, visual effects, layout styling, and configurable theme controls through permanent or dynamic plugin installation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的《赛博朋克 2077》风格界面主题，包含霓虹配色、字体、视觉效果和主题开关。
summaries.en: A configurable Cyberpunk 2077-inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness with neon colors, typography, visual effects, and theme controls.

capabilities: Applies client-side color tokens and CSS styling to the DeepSeek Harness interface
Adds theme settings and enable/disable controls
Supports persistent bundle installation and temporary dynamic plugin installation
Imports web fonts from Google Fonts
